### memoryHost()

```ts
function memoryHost(options?): Promise<Readonly<{
  agent: ShiitakeOwnerAgent;
  reconcile: () => Promise<void>;
  settle: (sessionId, maxTicks?, beforeRead?) => Promise<Readonly<{
     sessionId: string;
     cursor: string | null;
     hasMore: boolean;
     oldestCursor?: string | null;
     messages: readonly Readonly<{
        requestId?: ... | ...;
        meta?: ... | ...;
        data?: ... | ...;
        origin?: ... | ...;
        id: string;
        sequence: number;
        commandId: ... | ...;
        value: ModelMessage;
     }>[];
     terminals: readonly Readonly<{
        commandId: string;
        outcome: ... | ... | ... | ...;
        sequence: number;
        diagnostic: ... | ...;
        meta?: ... | ...;
     }>[];
     compactions?: readonly Readonly<{
        id: ...;
        sequence: ...;
        at: ...;
        tokensBefore: ...;
        tokensAfter: ...;
        trigger: ...;
     }>[];
     compactionNotices?: readonly Readonly<{
        id: ...;
        sequence: ...;
        at: ...;
        trigger: ...;
        result: ...;
        diagnostic: ...;
     }>[];
     sandboxFailures?: readonly object[];
     pending: SessionPendingPrompts;
     activity: SessionActivity;
     progress:   | Readonly<{
        messageId: string;
        revision: number;
        text: string;
        thinking: string;
        textOffset: number;
        thinkingOffset: number;
        textTruncated: boolean;
        thinkingTruncated: boolean;
      }>
        | null;
     toolOutput: readonly Readonly<{
        toolCallId: string;
        revision: number;
        tail: string;
        droppedBytes: number;
        totalBytes: number;
     }>[];
     extensions: SessionExtensionSlots;
     attention: readonly object[];
     context?: Readonly<{
        tokens: number;
        window: ... | ...;
     }>;
  }>>;
  close: () => Promise<void>;
}>>;
```

Compose the real Shiitake runtime over an optional borrowed SQLite owner. Call
reconcile/settle explicitly after acceptance. Defaults use a faux model and
rejecting sandbox; custom callbacks are NOT isolation and retain host
privileges. No submitted JavaScript is evaluated by this helper.
